The main takeaway from our work is that
the (pt) evolution is a collective effect that can be used to study the evolution of the QGP.
the (pt) of hadrons produced in the hadronization of hot QCD medium can be used as a probe of the QGP freeze-out dynamics.

the collective evolution of the QCD matter from quark-gluonic to hadronic matter can be studied in detail with heavy hadrons, and the evolution can be traced from the QGP freeze-out to the hadronic freeze-out.
